/* ==========================================
   NEW INTRO & HANDOFF ANIMATION STYLES
   ========================================== */
.hub-reveal-system {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 9999;
    pointer-events: none;
    perspective: 800px; /* Enable 3D space */
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* The glowing frame/threshold */
.hub-reveal-system::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    width: 60vw;
    height: 70vh;
    max-width: 800px;
    max-height: 700px;
    border: 2px solid var(--coral);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(249, 111, 110, 0.4), inset 0 0 30px rgba(249, 111, 110, 0.2);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.5);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), opacity 0.8s ease;
}

/* When the frame is revealed */
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-frame::before {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
}

/* When the frame fades out */
.hub-reveal-system.is-fading-out::before {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(2);
    opacity: 0;
}

.service-image {
    position: absolute;
    width: 120px; /* Start smaller */
    height: 120px;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    opacity: 0;
    /* Start small and behind the frame in 3D space */
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(-200px) scale(0);
    transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.8s ease;
}
.service-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
}

/* Animate the shapes to fly through the frame and to their corners */
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-shapes .service-image {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(200px) scale(1.5); /* Move forward and grow */
}

/* Stagger the animations */
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-shapes .service-advisory { top: 12%; left: 12%; transition-delay: 0s; }
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-shapes .service-imc { top: 12%; left: 88%; transition-delay: 0.15s; }
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-shapes .service-scope { top: 88%; left: 12%; transition-delay: 0.3s; }
.hub-reveal-system.is-revealing-shapes .service-strategy { top: 88%; left: 88%; transition-delay: 0.45s; }

/* When fading out, just disappear */
.hub-reveal-system.is-fading-out .service-image {
    opacity: 0;
}
